title: Residues of starch manufacture and similar residues

review.classification: The complete UNSD notes at p. 199 distinguish starch manufacturing residues from cereal milling and sugar residues. The verified 23220 starch/gluten and 39130 residue boundaries distinguish the actual joint starch product from separated potato fibre. The AKV product original identifies the exact residual origin and fresh single-feed use.
review.state_and_route: AKV independently identifies fresh and ensiled alternatives. EFISC provides the separated potato pulp pathway mechanically dewatered for feed and contrasts pellet manufacture, primary starch and fruit-water recovery. The PCR conditions screening and dewatering on the supplier hand-off. It requires real state-specific moisture and receiving evidence.
review.quantity_and_allocation: Both editions retain the first-release wet Q, Q=0 treatment, separate wet and component balances, validated stocks and cohort traceability. They require the actually inherited upstream environmental vector once, use a documented causal and residual attributional hierarchy and protect physical conservation. Commercial examples supply neither default loss nor yield factors.
review.native_and_bilingual: Read and digest-matched the two pinned historical Mass and reference kg XML originals. All 42 facility exchange identities and the exact reference product UUID remain explicitly unresolved, with provider compatibility and collection dependent on application evidence. English and Chinese preserve the same scope, wet basis, inventory identifiers, process states and equations.

sources.role: Primary product datasheet distinguishes the fresh and ensiled states of mechanically dewatered potato-starch pulp.
Primary sector process reference for potato starch and mechanical pulp dewatering, with dry pellets and fruit-water co-products addressed separately.
Published consensus process diagram and description independently distinguish starch milk, potato pulp and the separate juice/protein co-product.
